summary: Proofs are mostly readable and use robust automation, but two places rely on unstated `OfNat`/`Nat.cast` definitional equality and on the raw shape of a `Set` union instead of the characterization lemmas provided in the same file; the ι-bracket transport block is duplicated verbatim from Straightening.lean, and six single-use private cast helpers restate one pattern three times.
